Bentonite seals the wall. It doesn't carry cuttings.
Two different jobs. Bentonite builds a filter cake and stabilises the bore. But getting cuttings out of the hole? That's not what it's designed to do on its own.

Without a carrier polymer, cuttings lag behind the fluid. They settle when you stop pumping. They pack around the rods. Then you're cleaning out instead of drilling.

A carrier polymer gels when the pump stops, holds cuttings in place, then flows clean when you start again. Carry Flow does this in 6 of our 9 standard fluid programs. 1 to 6 kg per 1000L, depending on the ground.
Running bentonite only? Give the team a call. We'll build a program that actually clears the hole.

Carry Flow. Six programs. One job.
It's in 6 of our 9 standard fluid programs because the job is always the same. Keep cuttings moving. Hold them when the pump stops.

Coated xanthan gum. Pour it through the hopper, it disperses clean. No lumps sitting in the bottom of the tank. Works in freshwater, saltwater, or brine.

Dose is 1 to 6 kg per 1000L. Pair it with your bentonite base, add clay inhibitors or lubricant for the ground, and the program does the work.
Not sure what program fits your ground? Give one of our team a call. We'll dial it in.
